headline: EVER jumps 120% over five days as Prop sector sees multiple 10% gainers and Food stocks record strong volume spikes.
market_take: Prop stocks were the most active, with EVER, RML and CGD each up 10% and a mix of declines in KUN and NVD. Food sector showed the highest one‑day gain from F&D (+18.75%) and several volume spikes across CH, FM, ICHI, OSP and SUN. Consumer and industrial names were mixed, highlighted by DEMCO’s 11.04% rise and unusual price gaps in SQ and TRITN. PF&REIT experienced extreme gaps, notably QHOP and M‑PAT at -100% open gaps.

sector_notes.note: Three Prop tickers (EVER, RML, CGD) posted +10% moves, while KUN and NVD fell around -9.6% each; JCK also saw a -7.69% intraday drop and filed a trading‑sign notice.
F&D led with +18.75% gain; multiple Food stocks (CH, FM, ICHI, OSP, SUN) recorded volume spikes ranging from 3.8σ to 8.6σ, and SST filed a CFO resignation and appointment.
DEMCO surged +11.04% with an intraday jump of +11.73%; SQ opened with a +5.56% gap and TRITN showed a -33.33% gap followed by a +50.00% intraday rise.
QHOP and M‑PAT each posted a -100.00% open gap; PF showed a -20.00% gap but rebounded +25.00% intraday.
VPO dropped -6.52% intraday amid a 3.1× volume increase.
STELLA filed a high‑priority clarification on land sale while its 5‑day performance is -13.3%.

watchlist.reason: Up +11.04% with intraday move of +11.73% and 5‑day +24.8%.
Intraday drop of -7.69% and high‑priority trading‑sign filing.
Open gap of +10.00% and intraday decline of -9.09%.
Open gap of -20.00% followed by +25.00% intraday move.

risk_flags: Prop sector concentration in multiple 10% movers may increase short‑term volatility.
Food volume spikes could be transient and not reflect sustained price moves.
Extreme price gaps in PF&REIT (QHOP, M‑PAT) suggest liquidity risk.
DEMCO’s rapid intraday rise may be driven by speculative trading.
STELLA’s clarification filing adds uncertainty to its recent decline.
